# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game called **Liquid Sort: Hero Vial Audit**. Preserve the source mechanic truth: each round presents a random target made of one category and one color; the player taps one of three category buttons, one of three color buttons, and a single submit button. A correct submit awards 100 points, restores 15 timer points capped at 100, increases difficulty by 0.05, and advances to a new request. A wrong submit subtracts 20 timer points. The timer drains only while the requester waits, and expiration opens a game-over/restart state.

Reinterpret the loop as a satirical liquid-sort puzzle in a legally-distinct pastel adventure shrine. The central focal identity is a sleepy hero vial wearing a small green cap. The requester is a fairy clerk issuing “sort game writs.” Category buttons read Bottle, Flask, and Chalice while retaining the old internal categories. Color buttons represent Ruby, Azure, and Lime potion liquids. Visuals should be procedural Canvas/CSS: rainbow waterfalls, soft dungeon tiles, floating triangle runes, glassmorphism HUD, and meme-tone copy such as “real potion,” “no thoughts,” and “clock goblin.” Keep all controls large and reachable in 4:7 to 9:16 portrait mobile.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: fast single-board selection puzzle / color-and-type matching score chase
- objective: satisfy each random request by selecting the matching category and color, then submitting before the timer drains
- input model: one-thumb friendly taps on three type buttons, three color buttons, and one submit button
- core loop: start session, receive random target, choose two attributes, submit, gain score/time on match or lose time on mismatch, repeat until timer reaches zero
- fail/friction state: wrong submit subtracts time; timer expiration ends the run and shows restart

## Protected mechanics
- Three mutually exclusive type choices and three mutually exclusive color choices.
- Random target contains exactly one type and one color.
- Submit compares selected type and color against the target; no spatial collision or physics are involved.
- Correct match adds 100 score, adds 15 time capped at 100, raises difficulty multiplier by 0.05, spawns feedback, and moves to the next request.
- Incorrect match subtracts 20 time and keeps the same request active.
- Timer drains by 0.05 multiplied by difficulty only while the requester is waiting.
- Session ends only when time reaches zero; restart resets score, time, difficulty, and selected defaults.

## Remixed target
Liquid Sort: Hero Vial Audit preserves the selection/match/timer score chase while reframing it as a satirical pastel-dungeon liquid sort puzzle. The player pilots a sleepy hero vial, a fairy clerk issues potion writs, shape choices are Bottle/Flask/Chalice, color choices are Ruby/Azure/Lime liquid layers, and the HUD speaks in commute-friendly meme fantasy language. Presentation changes are canvas/DOM/native-CSS only; core rules remain unchanged.
